source_scope: orders_full operational source only; not Online Retail

decision_protocol.horizon_sensitivity_threshold_policy: Use the same predeclared 0/5/25 absolute-demand thresholds; exclude only cutoff-horizon pairs without a complete future window.
decision_protocol.observation_boundary: Only fulfilled demand events at or before the decision cutoff.
decision_protocol.outcome_boundary: Future fulfilled demand strictly after the decision cutoff through the next 60 days.
decision_protocol.eligibility: Historical fulfilled quantity must exceed 5 units.
decision_protocol.selection_rule: Thresholds are not changed using downstream model accuracy, calibration, SHAP, or held-out test performance.

labels.CRITICAL: future fulfilled quantity = 0 and historical fulfilled quantity > 5

alternative_strategy.role: Robustness comparator only; never a downstream-model tuning target.
alternative_strategy.critical_policy: future fulfilled quantity = 0 and historical fulfilled quantity > 5

validation_outputs.compare_by: rolling decision cutoff and temporal split
validation_outputs.interpretation_boundary: This validates a proxy for future fulfilled-demand risk. Physical inventory, cost, age, lifecycle, markdown and action outcomes are required to validate actual inventory and capital risk.
